source_claim: AlphaEvolve paper-facing benchmark claims require scoped fixtures, expert formulation, task targets, repeated-seed evidence, baseline values, emitted result artifacts, and anti-gaming checks
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has runtime readiness telemetry for example-scope registry linkage, smoke fixture scope, formulation/review metadata, task-spec identity, and benchmark hardening references when present, but does not claim non-smoke AlphaEvolve-comparable fixture scope, repeated-seed protocols, SOTA or target baseline values, fixture-emitted result artifacts, anti-gaming negative-fixture checks, or paper-claim-ready benchmark fixtures.
